name: Countercheck Buyer Gate
description: A local buyer-side agent that checks Concordium Agent Registry identities and compares seller native CCD x402 payment terms with a fixed spend cap before human review. Payment signing is currently disabled. Its MCP tools use local stdio; no public A2A or HTTP agent endpoint is deployed.

skills.name: Verify counterparties
skills.description: Checks active Concordium agent identity, Agent Card integrity, and registered payment-wallet associations.

skills.name: Request purchase quote
skills.description: Reads a seller x402 challenge and validates its native CCD payment terms against the configured spend cap. Requires a configured live seller resource URL.

extensions.description: Verified by Concordium badge — on-chain agent identity in a CIS-8004 registry

params.verify: Resolve tokenAddress via CIS-8004 agent_of; confirm owner + status=Active + card SHA-256 == metadata_hash.
